dogecoin.text: @Bitcoiner_Trump @monero @litecoin @dogecoin @zcash @Dashpay @KaspaCurrency @Ripple All your transactions are stored publicly. It only takes one mistake to reveal the identity of the people involved. The third party could be a government, company, competitor, thief, etc surveiling the chain and acting on that info.

@Bitcoiner_Trump @monero @litecoin @dogecoin @zcash @Dashpay @KaspaCurrency @Ripple I understood what you meant. And I said something else. If there's a choice to transact freely without fearing consequences coming from third parties, why not take it?
@Bitcoiner_Trump @monero @litecoin @dogecoin @zcash @Dashpay @KaspaCurrency @Ripple You're exactly wrong, using Bitcoin always involves a third party, the one taking a look at your transactions.
